claim: Lauret's computational study examines isospectrality among lens spaces and lens orbifolds for Hodge-Laplace operators on smooth p-forms (not just the scalar/function Laplacian), entirely in the spherical lens-space setting, with no hyperbolic or heat-coefficient content.
stance_target: whether this is a competitor to the manuscript's hyperbolic cone-orbifold priority claim
scope_conditions: lens spaces and lens orbifolds, Hodge-Laplace on p-forms
quoted_support: We make a computational study to know what kind of isospectralities among lens spaces and lens orbifolds exist considering the Hodge--Laplace operators acting on smooth $p$-forms. Several evidenced facts are proved and some others are conjectured.

claim: Published as Lauret, Experimental Mathematics 30:2 (2021), 268-282, DOI 10.1080/10586458.2018.1538908.
quoted_support: Journal reference: Exp. Math. 30:2 (2021), 268-282. Related DOI: https://doi.org/10.1080/10586458.2018.1538908
